explanations.label: ponzi_or_fraud
explanations.distinguishing_evidence: 100% monthly return compounds to ~409,500% annually, which is mathematically unsustainable for any legitimate investment; 10% referral bonus for inviting friends is characteristic of pyramid/ponzi schemes.

explanations.label: real_but_unlicensed
explanations.distinguishing_evidence: No evidence of actual business operations, products, or services; only promises of returns from deposits and referrals.

explanations.label: licensed_legitimate
explanations.distinguishing_evidence: No regulator claims, no license information, no verifiable corporate registration found.

explanations.label: impersonation
explanations.distinguishing_evidence: No evidence this entity is impersonating a known legitimate brand; appears to be a standalone scheme.
